mentions.name: Early retirement what-if planner
mentions.description: A retirement planning app that models what-if scenarios—such as how many years of work could be cut by downsizing to a smaller house or relocating to another state—and evaluates risks specifically for early retirement. It evolved from a calculator into a ProjectionLab-like tool and is a fully self-owned replacement for the author's long-suffering Excel planning sheet.
mentions.problem: Replaces a long-suffering Excel spreadsheet used for retirement planning; the spreadsheet didn't flag certain risks the app does.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building an app to replace a long-suffering Excel sheet I've used for retirement planning. Started off as a calculator, eventually turned into something like ProjectionLab, though with a focus on what-if scenarios (e.g., how many years can I knock off my working life if I downsize to a smaller house or relocate to another state?) and risk evaluation specifically for early retirement.
